pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Dark brown regions exhibit complex, irregular polygonal geometries with highly jagged, serrated edges (starburst-like). The edge gradients are sharp, with patches on the central flank occupying a larger relative spatial area than those on the lower neck.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A continuous topological web of light-colored negative space. Pathways show variable pixel thickness as they contour the jagged patch edges, converging at distinct multi-pathway junction nodes across the flank.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane along the dorsal neck presents a continuous, low-amplitude jagged silhouette with high-frequency frequency of fine textural projections against the background.
